content: Table TABREF28 presents the results of the first experiment. The DL model with GloVe word embeddings achieved better results on three datasets, with 82.80% Accuracy on SNLI, 78.52% Accuracy on MultiNLI, and 83.62% Accuracy on Quora. Logistic Regression achieved the best Accuracy of 98.60% on Clinical-RQE. We also performed a 10-fold cross-validation on the full Clinical-QE data of 8,588 question pairs, which gave 98.61% Accuracy.
